thread:
sara_finance: Heads-up — DeltaHealth sent renewal invoice INV-2024-5423 and there are a couple of odd line items. Platform fee looks like it was applied twice (hosted + onprem). Also support band auto-bumped to Premium after Q4 usage spike; contract says support band changes should be negotiated not auto-applied.

mike_sales: @sara_finance can you paste the invoice lines? I was told CS flagged extra platform fee during renewal call. :eyes:

sara_finance: Sure: 
```
Line 10: Platform fee - Private deployment - $120,000
Line 11: Platform fee - OnPrem addendum - $30,000
Line 18: Support - Premium - $45,000
```
Contract signed (DeltaHealth_SOW_v3) shows single Platform fee = $120,000 and Support = Standard $20,000 with optional Premium add-on by agreement.

tina_accounting: Invoice shows billing contact = billing@deltahealth.com, sent by billing@redwood-invoice. INV total = $195,000. It went into approvals queue.

oliver_finops: If the onprem addendum was meant as a one-time migration fee that should have been absorbed in previous quarter or quoted as professional services. Do we have a PO or redline that added the $30k?

mike_sales: I dug through the CLM — there is an addendum (MIG-2023-09) but it's marked as 'quote only' not executed. Sales never countersigned. I don't think the $30k charge is valid.

rebecca_se: We did run a heavy load test late Nov that spiked token usage. But the support band change requires a signed amendment per section 4.2. Not automatic.

billing-bot: Automated note: Invoice INV-2024-5423 created 2024-11-02 by billing@redwood-invoice. Payment terms NET30. Audit flag: support-band-change without amendment.

sara_finance: Proposed immediate actions: 1) Put invoice on hold (Tina) 2) Sales confirm addendum signature (Mike) 3) SE confirm whether support escalation was reactive vs contractual (Rebecca) 4) If charge invalid, request credit memo and corrected invoice; if charge valid, ask for supporting signed docs.

tina_accounting: I've put invoice on hold in Stripe and added memo "billing dispute - pending validation". Uploaded PDF to the ticket.

mike_sales: Confirmed — MIG-2023-09 is a quoted SOW that was never countersigned. No PO. Will reach out to DeltaHealth AE today and cc legal.

rebecca_se: Support activity log: we opened several Priority 1 incidents during Nov 20-26 due to a misunderstanding in KV cache warmup params; we provided remediation but no SLA upgrade was agreed. I'll bundle logs and incident timestamps.

oliver_finops: Two possibilities: (A) Accept a one-time credit for $30k platform addendum and keep support band as Standard for renewal = reduces invoice to $165k, or (B) if customer agrees to retroactive upgrade to Premium, need signed amendment and back-billing justification. Finance prefers (A) to close quickly unless Sales can get signed amendment.

sara_finance: Agreed. Can Sales try to get a signed addendum by EOD tomorrow? If not, issue a credit memo for $30k and revert support to Standard.

mike_sales: I'll ping DeltaHealth now. If AE can't get signature I'll propose the credit.

tina_accounting: If credit memo goes through, note: platform fee offset must be applied to the same invoice run to avoid duplicate platform fee recognition in revenue system. I'll coordinate with RevOps.

billing-bot: Action items recorded: ticket #BIL-7892 created. Assigned: tina_accounting (hold invoice), mike_sales (contract confirmation), rebecca_se (incident evidence), oliver_finops (credit recommendation). Due 2024-11-08.

sara_finance: Perfect. Keep this thread updated. Also @mike_sales if they accept credit, ask if they want the credit applied to this invoice or to next renewal (capture preference).

mike_sales: Will update within 24hrs. If DeltaHealth requests credit to next invoice, note potential revenue deferral — loop in RevOps (tina will handle).

tina_accounting: Added RevOps alias to the ticket.

rebecca_se: Posting incident logs now.

mike_sales: DeltaHealth AE confirmed over DM: they never signed the addendum and prefer immediate credit to this invoice. Requesting a small goodwill SLA credit too for the November incidents.

oliver_finops: For goodwill SLA credit: recommend $5k cap per incident group. If we do $5k goodwill, total credit = $35k. Finance ok with that as long as Sales documents acceptance.

sara_finance: Sounds reasonable. Tina — can you issue credit memo for $35k and reissue corrected invoice today? Need to get cashflow visibility for month close.

tina_accounting: Will draft credit memo CM-2024-114 and corrected invoice INV-2024-5423R. Posting for approval now.

mike_sales: I'll get written confirmation from DeltaHealth accepting credit and waiver of future back-billing for this period.

sara_finance: Thanks team. Closing loop once CM and corrected invoice are in the system. :thumbsup:
